quote: Both challenge methods led to similar clinical manifestations in all infected fish, including congestion of the head skin, visceral congestion, ascites containing red blood cells comprising 2–5% of body weight, and intestines containing a jelly-like mucus ( Figure 7 D–I).
statement: 两种攻毒方法导致所有受感染鱼出现相似的临床症状，包括头部皮肤充血、内脏充血、含有占体重2-5%红细胞的腹水以及肠道内含有果冻状粘液。
text_zh: 两种攻毒方法导致所有受感染鱼出现相似的临床症状，包括头部皮肤充血、内脏充血、含有占体重2-5%红细胞的腹水以及肠道内含有果冻状粘液。
text_en: Two challenge methods resulted in similar clinical signs in all infected fish, including congestion of the head skin, visceral congestion, ascites containing red blood cells accounting for 2-5% of body weight, and jelly-like mucus in the intestines.

quote: Fish in the control group remained healthy ( Figure 7 J–M).
statement: 对照组的鱼保持健康。
text_zh: 对照组的鱼保持健康。
text_en: The fish in the control group remained healthy.

quote: In the bath challenge of fry fish, mortality rapidly increased during 6–24 hpi, reaching 83.6% by 48 hpi.
statement: 在仔鱼的浸泡攻毒中，死亡率在感染后6-24小时内迅速增加，到48小时达到83.6%。
text_zh: 在仔鱼的浸泡攻毒中，死亡率在感染后6-24小时内迅速增加，到48小时达到83.6%。
text_en: In immersion challenge of fry, mortality increased rapidly within 6-24 hours post-infection, reaching 83.6% by 48 hours.

quote: However, at 48 hpi, the control group also exhibited modest mortality of 19.9%.
statement: 然而，在感染后48小时，对照组也表现出19.9%的轻微死亡率。
text_zh: 然而，在感染后48小时，对照组也表现出19.9%的轻微死亡率。
text_en: However, at 48 hours post-infection, the control group also showed a slight mortality rate of 19.9%.

quote: Consequently, the mortality rate in MFBV-infected fry was adjusted using Abbott’s formula, yielding a corrected value of 79.5%.
statement: 因此，使用Abbott公式对MFBV感染的仔鱼死亡率进行了调整，得出校正值为79.5%。
text_zh: 因此，使用Abbott公式对MFBV感染的仔鱼死亡率进行了调整，得出校正值为79.5%。
text_en: Therefore, the mortality of larvae infected with MFBV was adjusted using Abbott's formula, resulting in a corrected value of 79.5%.

quote: The p -values between the infected group and the control group were 0.0001 (Kaplan–Meier survival analysis) ( Figure 7 C).
statement: 感染组与对照组之间的p值为0.0001（Kaplan-Meier生存分析）。
text_zh: 感染组与对照组之间的p值为0.0001（Kaplan-Meier生存分析）。
text_en: The p-value between the infected group and the control group was 0.0001 (Kaplan-Meier survival analysis).

quote: In the immersion experiment with the same titer, the virulence of MFBV to fry was higher than that of juvenile fish.
statement: 在相同滴度的浸泡实验中，MFBV对仔鱼的毒力高于对幼鱼的毒力。
text_zh: 在相同滴度的浸泡实验中，MFBV对仔鱼的毒力高于对幼鱼的毒力。
text_en: In immersion experiments with the same titer, MFBV was more virulent to fry than to juvenile fish.

quote: Furthermore, the viscera homogenates of deceased fish tested positive for MFBV by RT-qPCR, while those of control fish tested negative.
statement: 此外，死亡鱼的内脏匀浆通过RT-qPCR检测呈MFBV阳性，而对照鱼的内脏匀浆呈阴性。
text_zh: 此外，死亡鱼的内脏匀浆通过RT-qPCR检测呈MFBV阳性，而对照鱼的内脏匀浆呈阴性。
text_en: In addition, internal organ homogenates of dead fish tested positive for MFBV by RT-qPCR detection, while internal organ homogenates of control fish were negative.

quote: These results collectively demonstrate the pathogenicity of MFBV in both juvenile and fry mandarin fish.
statement: 这些结果共同证明了MFBV对鳜鱼幼鱼和仔鱼的致病性。
text_zh: 这些结果共同证明了MFBV对鳜鱼幼鱼和仔鱼的致病性。
text_en: These results collectively demonstrate the pathogenicity of MFBV to juvenile and larval mandarin fish.

quote: The results showed that aldehyde-based disinfectants have strong inactivation efficacy against MFBV, with glutaraldehyde being the most effective.
statement: 醛类消毒剂对MFBV具有强灭活效力，其中戊二醛最有效。
text_zh: 醛类消毒剂对MFBV具有强灭活效力，其中戊二醛最有效。
text_en: Aldehyde disinfectants have strong inactivation efficacy against MFBV, with glutaraldehyde being the most effective.

quote: Povidone-iodine, an iodine-based disinfectant, reduced the titer by 4 Log 10 TCID 50 at 2000 ppm, and 20,000 ppm resulted in an 8 Log 10 TCID 50 reduction.
statement: 碘伏在2000 ppm时使病毒滴度降低4个对数单位，在20,000 ppm时降低8个对数单位。
text_zh: 碘伏在2000 ppm时使病毒滴度降低4个对数单位，在20,000 ppm时降低8个对数单位。

quote: For benzalkonium bromide, 600 ppm reduced the titer by 4 Log 10 TCID 50 , 6000 ppm by 7 Log 10 TCID 50 , and 60,000 ppm by 8 Log 10 TCID 50 .
statement: 苯扎溴铵在600 ppm时使病毒滴度降低4个对数单位，6000 ppm时降低7个对数单位，60,000 ppm时降低8个对数单位。
text_zh: 苯扎溴铵在600 ppm时使病毒滴度降低4个对数单位，6000 ppm时降低7个对数单位，60,000 ppm时降低8个对数单位。

quote: Hydrogen peroxide reduced the titer by 4 Log 10 TCID 50 at 6000 ppm and 8 Log 10 TCID 50 at 20,000 ppm, while potassium permanganate achieved a reduction of 5 Log 10 TCID 50 at 2000 ppm and 8 Log 10 TCID 50 at 20,000 ppm.
statement: 过氧化氢在6000 ppm时使病毒滴度降低4个对数单位，20,000 ppm时降低8个对数单位；高锰酸钾在2000 ppm时降低5个对数单位，20,000 ppm时降低8个对数单位。
text_zh: 过氧化氢在6000 ppm时使病毒滴度降低4个对数单位，20,000 ppm时降低8个对数单位；高锰酸钾在2000 ppm时降低5个对数单位，20,000 ppm时降低8个对数单位。

quote: While povidone-iodine, formaldehyde, sodium hypochlorite, hydrogen peroxide, and potassium permanganate required concentrations in the 10 3 ppm range to achieve similar efficacy.
statement: 而碘伏、甲醛、次氯酸钠、过氧化氢和高锰酸钾需要10^3 ppm范围内的浓度才能实现类似的效力。
text_zh: 而碘伏、甲醛、次氯酸钠、过氧化氢和高锰酸钾需要10^3 ppm范围内的浓度才能实现类似的效力。
text_en: Iodophor, formaldehyde, sodium hypochlorite, hydrogen peroxide, and potassium permanganate require concentrations in the range of 10^3 ppm to achieve similar efficacy.

quote: Due to the rapid onset of disease and death, inflammatory responses such as immune cell infiltration were not identified in the sections, although cell death was clearly observed.
statement: 由于疾病和死亡发作迅速，切片中未识别出免疫细胞浸润等炎症反应，但观察到明显的细胞死亡。
text_zh: 由于疾病和死亡发作迅速，切片中未识别出免疫细胞浸润等炎症反应，但观察到明显的细胞死亡。
text_en: Due to the rapid onset of disease and death, inflammatory responses such as immune cell infiltration were not identified in sections, but obvious cell death was observed.

population.species: MFBV感染的鱼类（文中提及大口黑鲈、石斑鱼幼鱼及鳜鱼苗种）

quote: Overall, MFBV caused severe damage to the spleen, kidney, and intestines.
statement: 总体而言，MFBV对脾脏、肾脏和肠道造成了严重损害。
text_zh: 总体而言，MFBV对脾脏、肾脏和肠道造成了严重损害。
text_en: Overall, MFBV caused severe damage to the spleen, kidney and intestine.

quote: Additionally, in the fry immersion infection experiment, the 19.9% mortality observed in the fry control group is consistent with natural patterns observed in fish breeding.
statement: 此外，在仔鱼浸泡感染实验中，对照组观察到的19.9%死亡率与鱼类养殖中观察到的自然模式一致。
text_zh: 此外，在仔鱼浸泡感染实验中，对照组观察到的19.9%死亡率与鱼类养殖中观察到的自然模式一致。
text_en: In addition, in the immersion infection experiment of larvae, the 19.9% mortality observed in the control group is consistent with natural patterns observed in fish farming.

quote: In field breeding of mandarin fish, similar losses are often observed due to factors such as handling stress, cannibalism, developmental abnormalities, and other environmental stressors.
statement: 在鳜鱼的现场养殖中，常因操作应激、同类相食、发育异常和其他环境压力等因素导致类似的损失。
text_zh: 在鳜鱼的现场养殖中，常因操作应激、同类相食、发育异常和其他环境压力等因素导致类似的损失。
text_en: In field farming of mandarin fish, similar losses are often caused by factors such as handling stress, cannibalism, developmental abnormalities, and other environmental stresses.

quote: It is noteworthy that the threat of MFBV to fry is greater than that to juveniles, as evidenced by the higher mortality rate of fry (approximately 30–40% higher).
statement: 值得注意的是，MFBV对仔鱼的威胁大于对幼鱼的威胁，这表现为仔鱼更高的死亡率（约高30-40%）。
text_zh: 值得注意的是，MFBV对仔鱼的威胁大于对幼鱼的威胁，这表现为仔鱼更高的死亡率（约高30-40%）。
text_en: It is worth noting that MFBV poses a greater threat to fry than to juveniles, as evidenced by the higher mortality rate in fry (about 30-40% higher).
outcome: 不同生长阶段的易感性差异

quote: To mitigate MFBV outbreaks, we tested its sensitivity to various disinfectants.
statement: 为了减轻MFBV的爆发，我们测试了其对各种消毒剂的敏感性。
text_zh: 为了减轻MFBV的爆发，我们测试了其对各种消毒剂的敏感性。
text_en: To mitigate MFBV outbreaks, we tested its sensitivity to various disinfectants.

quote: In the artificial infection experiments of LBBV in bass, a similar rapid mortality was observed, with deaths occurring after 24 hpi, reaching 100% by 3 dpi.
statement: 在鲈鱼LBBV的人工感染实验中，观察到类似的快速死亡，死亡发生在感染后24小时，并在感染后3天达到100%。
text_zh: 在鲈鱼LBBV的人工感染实验中，观察到类似的快速死亡，死亡发生在感染后24小时，并在感染后3天达到100%。
text_en: In the artificial infection experiment of LBBV in sea bass, similar rapid deaths were observed, with deaths occurring 24 hours after infection and reaching 100% by 3 days after infection.

quote: However, MFBV infection in mandarin fish caused mortality as early as 6 hpi, which could be attributed to the higher infectious dose used in this study, as well as potential differences between viral strains and host species.
statement: 然而，鳜鱼中的MFBV感染早在感染后6小时就导致死亡，这可能归因于本研究中使用的较高感染剂量，以及病毒株和宿主物种之间的潜在差异。
text_zh: 然而，鳜鱼中的MFBV感染早在感染后6小时就导致死亡，这可能归因于本研究中使用的较高感染剂量，以及病毒株和宿主物种之间的潜在差异。
text_en: However, MFBV infection in mandarin fish led to death as early as 6 hours post-infection, which may be attributed to the higher infectious dose used in this study, as well as potential differences between the virus strain and host species.

quote: It is speculated that severe systemic infection is another factor contributing to the rapid mortality.
statement: 据推测，严重的全身性感染是导致快速死亡的另一个因素。
text_zh: 据推测，严重的全身性感染是导致快速死亡的另一个因素。
text_en: Severe systemic infection is speculated to be another factor leading to rapid death.

quote: For example, IPNV was shown to cause mortality rates of approximately 80% in experimental infections [ 50 ].
statement: 例如，IPNV在实验感染中显示出约80%的死亡率。
text_zh: 例如，IPNV在实验感染中显示出约80%的死亡率。
text_en: For example, IPNV showed about 80% mortality in experimental infection.

quote: In one pond of the PF group, some fish appeared to have a disease in accordance with the method recommended by Office International des Épizooties [ 50 ]. The results revealed that they had ISKNV infection.
statement: 在PF组的一个池塘中，部分鱼表现出疾病症状，经检测确认为ISKNV感染。
text_zh: 在PF组的一个池塘中，部分鱼表现出疾病症状，经检测确认为ISKNV感染。
text_en: In one pond of the PF group, some fish showed disease symptoms and were confirmed to have ISKNV infection upon testing.

quote: Clove oil (30–40 mg/L) was used for anesthesia.
statement: 使用丁香油（30–40 mg/L）进行麻醉。
text_zh: 使用丁香油（30–40 mg/L）进行麻醉。
text_en: Anesthesia using clove oil (30–40 mg/L).
outcome: 屠宰/处理过程中的痛苦最小化

quote: An adequate re-feeding following a period of starvation or unfavorable environmental conditions can occur accelerated growth, which is called compensatory growth and has been widely studied in vertebrates
statement: 在经历一段饥饿或不利环境条件后，适当的再喂养可以导致加速生长，这种现象被称为补偿性生长。
text_zh: 在经历一段饥饿或不利环境条件后，适当的再喂养可以导致加速生长，这种现象被称为补偿性生长。
text_en: After a period of starvation or unfavorable environmental conditions, appropriate refeeding can lead to accelerated growth; this phenomenon is known as compensatory growth.

quote: Hepcidin treatment can significantly improve the survival rate of C. idellus infected with Flavobacterium columnare [ 22 ] and T. fasciatus infected with Vibrio anguillarum [ 26 ].
statement: 铁调素处理可显著提高感染柱状黄杆菌的草鱼和感染鳗弧菌的T. fasciatus的存活率。
text_zh: 铁调素处理可显著提高感染柱状黄杆菌的草鱼和感染鳗弧菌的T. fasciatus的存活率。
text_en: Hepcidin treatment significantly increased the survival rate of grass carp infected with Flavobacterium columnare and T. fasciatus infected with Vibrio anguillarum.

quote: The mRNA expression levels of hepcidin in B. lenok [ 27 ] and S. trutta [ 28 ] significantly increased after they were infected with Aeromonas salmonicida and A. hydrophila .
statement: B. lenok和S. trutta在感染杀鲑气单胞菌和嗜水气单胞菌后，铁调素的mRNA表达水平显著增加。
text_zh: B. lenok和S. trutta在感染杀鲑气单胞菌和嗜水气单胞菌后，铁调素的mRNA表达水平显著增加。
text_en: The mRNA expression levels of hepcidin significantly increased in B. lenok and S. trutta after infection with Aeromonas salmonicida and Aeromonas hydrophila.
outcome: 基因表达响应/免疫激活

quote: Platichthys stellatus hepcidin can inhibit the activity of V. parahaemolyticus and Edwardsella tarda [ 47 ].
statement: 星突江鲽的铁调素可以抑制副溶血弧菌和迟爱德华氏菌的活性。
text_zh: 星突江鲽的铁调素可以抑制副溶血弧菌和迟爱德华氏菌的活性。
text_en: Hepcidin from Platichthys stellatus can inhibit the activity of Vibrio parahaemolyticus and Edwardsiella tarda.

quote: Many biological processes, including development, immune, stress response, and adaptive evolution can be mapped, annotated and understood by RNA-seq.
statement: RNA-seq可用于映射、注释和理解包括免疫和应激反应在内的多种生物过程。
text_zh: RNA-seq可用于映射、注释和理解包括免疫和应激反应在内的多种生物过程。
text_en: RNA-seq can be used to map, annotate, and understand various biological processes, including immune and stress responses.

quote: It has been reported that fasting promotes the metabolic actions of GH rather than the growth-promoting actions [46]
statement: 据报道，禁食促进生长激素的代谢作用而非促生长作用。
text_zh: 据报道，禁食促进生长激素的代谢作用而非促生长作用。
text_en: It is reported that fasting promotes the metabolic effects of growth hormone rather than its growth-promoting effects.

quote: Domesticated rainbow trout may reduce innate immunity and change iron balance, involving more iron in hemoglobin synthesis [ 49 ].
statement: 驯化的虹鳟可能降低先天免疫力并改变铁平衡，使更多铁参与血红蛋白合成。
text_zh: 驯化的虹鳟可能降低先天免疫力并改变铁平衡，使更多铁参与血红蛋白合成。
text_en: Domesticated rainbow trout may have reduced innate immunity and altered iron balance, with more iron involved in hemoglobin synthesis.

quote: In this study, high expression of the Sc-hep gene through short-term domestication may be related to immune stress of S. chuatsi .
statement: 本研究中，短期驯化导致的Sc-hep基因高表达可能与鳜鱼的免疫应激有关。
text_zh: 本研究中，短期驯化导致的Sc-hep基因高表达可能与鳜鱼的免疫应激有关。
text_en: In this study, the high expression of the Sc-hep gene caused by short-term acclimation may be related to immune stress in mandarin fish.

quote:
In this study, the IGFR1 expression markedly rose during fasting

(Fig. 7 IGFR1), illustrating that IGFR1 expression will increase to restrict IGF-I during starvation, which is
probably related to the anti-apoptotic effects reported in mammals [38].
statement: 在本研究中，IGFR1表达在禁食期间显著上升，说明IGFR1表达会在饥饿期间增加以限制IGF-I，这可能与哺乳动物中报道的抗凋亡作用有关。
text_zh: 在本研究中，IGFR1表达在禁食期间显著上升，说明IGFR1表达会在饥饿期间增加以限制IGF-I，这可能与哺乳动物中报道的抗凋亡作用有关。
text_en: In this study, IGFR1 expression significantly increased during fasting, indicating that IGFR1 expression increases during starvation to limit IGF-I, which may be related to the anti-apoptotic effect reported in mammals.

quote: In conclusion, we speculate that the expression of upstream IGFR1 will promote the expression of downstream 4ebp through the above-mentioned pathways in the case of starvation, so as to cope with the food restriction.
statement: 作者推测在饥饿情况下，上游IGFR1的表达将通过上述途径促进下游4ebp的表达，以应对食物限制。
text_zh: 作者推测在饥饿情况下，上游IGFR1的表达将通过上述途径促进下游4ebp的表达，以应对食物限制。
text_en: The authors speculate that under starvation conditions, the expression of upstream IGFR1 will promote the expression of downstream 4ebp through the aforementioned pathway to cope with food restriction.

quote: In the first week, the weight of the experimental group decreased markedly following the induction of starvation, as indicated by a negative SGR (-0.98) which reached the lowest (-2.62) in the second week.
statement: 在禁食诱导后的第一周，实验组鱼体重显著下降，比生长速率（SGR）为负值（-0.98），并在第二周达到最低点（-2.62）。
text_zh: 在禁食诱导后的第一周，实验组鱼体重显著下降，比生长速率（SGR）为负值（-0.98），并在第二周达到最低点（-2.62）。
text_en: In the first week after fasting induction, the body weight of fish in the experimental group decreased significantly, with a specific growth rate (SGR) of -0.98, reaching its lowest point (-2.62) in the second week.

quote: During the following week of re-feeding, the weight of the experimental group increased rapidly and resulted in a positive of SGR (2.99), which was significantly higher than (P < 0.01) that in the control group.
statement: 在随后的重新投喂期间，实验组鱼体重迅速增加，比生长速率（SGR）为正（2.99），且显著高于对照组。
text_zh: 在随后的重新投喂期间，实验组鱼体重迅速增加，比生长速率（SGR）为正（2.99），且显著高于对照组。
text_en: During the subsequent refeeding period, the body weight of fish in the experimental group increased rapidly, with a positive specific growth rate (SGR) of 2.99, which was significantly higher than that of the control group.

quote: The bodyweight difference of experiment and controls ultimately was no significant difference, indicating that the experimental groups achieved complete compensatory growth after re-feeding.
statement: 实验组与对照组的最终体重差异无统计学意义，表明实验组在重新投喂后实现了完全补偿性生长。
text_zh: 实验组与对照组的最终体重差异无统计学意义，表明实验组在重新投喂后实现了完全补偿性生长。
text_en: The difference in final body weight between the experimental group and the control group was not statistically significant, indicating that the experimental group achieved complete compensatory growth after refeeding.

quote: During starvation, the expression of GHR2, IGFR1 and 4ebp was up-regulated, and the difference of expression increased with the increase of starvation time, and the expression was close to that of the control group following re-feeding (Fig. 7).
statement: 在禁食期间，GHR2、IGFR1和4ebp的表达上调，且表达差异随禁食时间延长而增加；重新投喂后，其表达水平接近对照组。
text_zh: 在禁食期间，GHR2、IGFR1和4ebp的表达上调，且表达差异随禁食时间延长而增加；重新投喂后，其表达水平接近对照组。
text_en: During fasting, the expression of GHR2, IGFR1 and 4ebp was upregulated, and the differences in expression increased with longer fasting duration; after refeeding, their expression levels approached those of the control group.

quote: The expression levels of Mhc, Mlc, troponin and MyoD in starvation revealed the descent tendency, however, there was n
statement: 禁食期间Mhc、Mlc、肌钙蛋白和MyoD的表达水平呈现下降趋势。
text_zh: 禁食期间Mhc、Mlc、肌钙蛋白和MyoD的表达水平呈现下降趋势。
text_en: During the fasting period, the expression levels of Mhc, Mlc, troponin, and MyoD showed a downward trend.
outcome: 肌肉发育相关基因表达

quote:
During
fasting conditions, the markedly down-regulated of Mhc and Mlc indicated that muscle protein synthesis
decreased (Fig. 7 Mhc and Mlc), and muscle proteins may be used as the major energy source to
maintain basic metabolism which limited growth and was consistent with the observed reduced weight
statement: 禁食条件下，Mhc和Mlc显著下调表明肌肉蛋白合成减少，肌肉蛋白可能被用作维持基本代谢的主要能量来源，从而限制了生长并导致体重减轻。
text_zh: 禁食条件下，Mhc和Mlc显著下调表明肌肉蛋白合成减少，肌肉蛋白可能被用作维持基本代谢的主要能量来源，从而限制了生长并导致体重减轻。
text_en: Under fasting conditions, the significant downregulation of Mhc and Mlc indicates reduced muscle protein synthesis; muscle protein may be used as the primary energy source to maintain basic metabolism, thereby limiting growth and leading to weight loss.

quote:
In the meantime, because muscle breakdown and muscle protein synthesis were inhibited,
muscle contraction and motor function were restrained, which was manifested as a significant decrease
in troponin expression (Fig. 7 Troponin).
statement: 由于肌肉分解和肌肉蛋白合成受到抑制，肌肉收缩和运动功能受限，表现为肌钙蛋白表达显著下降。
text_zh: 由于肌肉分解和肌肉蛋白合成受到抑制，肌肉收缩和运动功能受限，表现为肌钙蛋白表达显著下降。
text_en: Due to inhibited muscle breakdown and muscle protein synthesis, muscle contraction and motor function are limited, manifested as a significant decrease in troponin expression.
outcome: 运动功能与肌肉生理状态

quote:
After re-feeding, significant up-regulation of Mhc and Mlc was
observed (Fig. 7 Mhc and Mlc), showing that muscle protein was no longer used as the major energy
source, and synthesis of muscle and rapid compensatory growth occurred, which resulted in increased
weight [56].
statement: 重新喂食后，观察到Mhc和Mlc显著上调，表明肌肉蛋白不再作为主要能量来源，发生了肌肉合成和快速补偿性生长，从而导致体重增加。
text_zh: 重新喂食后，观察到Mhc和Mlc显著上调，表明肌肉蛋白不再作为主要能量来源，发生了肌肉合成和快速补偿性生长，从而导致体重增加。
text_en: After refeeding, Mhc and Mlc were observed to be significantly upregulated, indicating that muscle protein was no longer the main energy source, muscle synthesis and rapid compensatory growth occurred, leading to weight gain.

quote: The fish larvae were cultured in different cement ponds (5 m × 3 m × 1.5 m) with a continuous water filtration system 2 weeks after hatching.
statement: 鱼苗在孵化后2周被养殖在带有连续水过滤系统的水泥池中。
text_zh: 鱼苗在孵化后2周被养殖在带有连续水过滤系统的水泥池中。
text_en: Fish fry were reared in concrete tanks with a continuous water filtration system 2 weeks after hatching.

quote: The first group was continuously cultured with the live prey fish and served as a control group (PF group).
statement: 第一组持续使用活饵鱼进行养殖，作为对照组（PF组）。
text_zh: 第一组持续使用活饵鱼进行养殖，作为对照组（PF组）。
text_en: The first group was continuously farmed using live bait fish as a control group (PF group).

quote: In this group, 20 days after hatching, the fish in the AF group were trained to accept dead prey fish.
statement: 在AF组中，孵化后20天，训练鱼类接受死饵鱼。
text_zh: 在AF组中，孵化后20天，训练鱼类接受死饵鱼。
text_en: In the AF group, at 20 days post-hatching, fish were trained to accept dead baitfish.

quote: Then, 40 days after hatching, they were trained to accept artificial diet gradually in 2 weeks.
statement: 随后，在孵化后40天，它们在2周内逐渐被训练接受人工饲料。
text_zh: 随后，在孵化后40天，它们在2周内逐渐被训练接受人工饲料。
text_en: Subsequently, at 40 days post-hatching, they were gradually trained to accept artificial feed over a period of 2 weeks.

quote: Group 3 was injected with LPS (Sigma Chemical Co., St. Louis, MO, USA, 0.04 mg/kg of BW, LPS dissolved in PBS;).
statement: 第3组注射了脂多糖（LPS），剂量为0.04 mg/kg体重。
text_zh: 第3组注射了脂多糖（LPS），剂量为0.04 mg/kg体重。
text_en: Group 3 was injected with lipopolysaccharide (LPS) at a dose of 0.04 mg/kg body weight.

quote: The water temperature was maintained at 25–26 °C, and the compensatory growth experiment laste
statement: 实验期间水温维持在25-26°C，进行补偿生长实验。
text_zh: 实验期间水温维持在25-26°C，进行补偿生长实验。
text_en: During the experimental period, water temperature was maintained at 25-26°C for a compensatory growth experiment.

quote: The experimental fish were fed under uniform conditions; they were provided adequate live fish as bait twice daily at 0900 and 1800 hours.
statement: 实验鱼在统一条件下饲养，每天09:00和18:00两次提供充足的活鱼作为饵料。
text_zh: 实验鱼在统一条件下饲养，每天09:00和18:00两次提供充足的活鱼作为饵料。
text_en: The experimental fish were reared under uniform conditions, with sufficient live fish provided as feed twice daily at 09:00 and 18:00.

quote: The water temperature was maintained at 25–26 °C.
statement: 水温维持在25-26°C。
text_zh: 水温维持在25-26°C。
text_en: Water temperature was maintained at 25-26°C.

quote: All of the above experimental fish were anesthetized with tricaine methanesulfonate (MS-222, 100 mg/L) and sacrificed via decapitation for subsequent sampling
statement: 所有上述实验鱼均使用三卡因甲磺酸盐（MS-222，100 mg/L）麻醉并通过断头处死以进行后续采样。
text_zh: 所有上述实验鱼均使用三卡因甲磺酸盐（MS-222，100 mg/L）麻醉并通过断头处死以进行后续采样。
text_en: All the above experimental fish were anesthetized with tricaine methanesulfonate (MS-222, 100 mg/L) and euthanized by decapitation for subsequent sampling.

quote: During an initial 3 weeks of fasting, food was withheld from the experimental group, while that of the control group was maintained at a normal level.
statement: 实验组在最初3周内禁食，而对照组维持正常喂食水平。
text_zh: 实验组在最初3周内禁食，而对照组维持正常喂食水平。
text_en: The experimental group was fasted for the first 3 weeks, while the control group maintained normal feeding levels.

quote: After this, both the experimental group and the control group were fed continuously during the following 3 weeks.
statement: 禁食期结束后，实验组和对照组在接下来的3周内连续投喂。
text_zh: 禁食期结束后，实验组和对照组在接下来的3周内连续投喂。
text_en: After the fasting period ended, the experimental group and the control group were fed continuously for the next 3 weeks.

quote: SCRV infection can lead to visceral and skin bleeding, high morbidity and mortality
statement: SCRV感染可导致内脏和皮肤出血，以及高发病率和死亡率。
text_zh: SCRV感染可导致内脏和皮肤出血，以及高发病率和死亡率。
text_en: SCRV infection can cause hemorrhage in internal organs and skin, as well as high morbidity and mortality.

quote: Interestingly, during the starvation period, the expression of MyoD fell to the lowest level and then increased following the weight loss. After re-feeding, the expression gradually decreased from the highest level, and during the whole process, the expression had a certain delayed (Fig. 7 MyoD). But, the expression of Myf6 was stable throughout the process.
statement: 在饥饿期间，MyoD表达降至最低水平，随后随体重减轻而增加；复喂后，表达从最高水平逐渐下降，整个过程存在一定延迟；而Myf6表达在整个过程中保持稳定。
text_zh: 在饥饿期间，MyoD表达降至最低水平，随后随体重减轻而增加；复喂后，表达从最高水平逐渐下降，整个过程存在一定延迟；而Myf6表达在整个过程中保持稳定。
text_en: During starvation, MyoD expression decreased to its lowest level and then increased with weight loss; after refeeding, expression gradually decreased from its highest level, with a certain delay throughout the process; whereas Myf6 expression remained stable throughout the entire process.

text_zh: 然而，使用雷帕霉素激活自噬降低了SCRV滴度。
text_en: However, using rapamycin to activate autophagy reduced SCRV titers.

quote: SCRV infection induced autophagy.
statement: SCRV感染诱导了自噬。
text_zh: SCRV感染诱导了自噬。
text_en: SCRV infection induced autophagy.

quote: 鳜鱼以伏击方式捕食, 采取特定的投食技术后, 鳜由伏击式转变为伏击追击式, 最后形成集群抢食活饵。
statement: 通过特定的投食技术，可以改变鳜鱼的捕食行为模式，使其从伏击式转变为集群抢食活饵。
text_zh: 通过特定的投食技术，可以改变鳜鱼的捕食行为模式，使其从伏击式转变为集群抢食活饵。
text_en: Through specific feeding techniques, the predatory behavior pattern of mandarin fish can be changed from ambush-style to schooling and competing for live bait.

quote: 苗种投放当天即投喂饵料, 前3 d 投喂过量的全活饵料鱼, 从第4 d 开始, 逐渐减少投喂量, 以驯化鳜形成快速准确的摄食反应, 此过程约需7 d 时间。
statement: 采用先过量投喂活饵再逐渐减少投喂量的方法，可在约7天内驯化鳜鱼形成快速准确的摄食反应。
text_zh: 采用先过量投喂活饵再逐渐减少投喂量的方法，可在约7天内驯化鳜鱼形成快速准确的摄食反应。
text_en: Using a method of first overfeeding live bait and then gradually reducing the feeding amount can domesticate mandarin fish to form rapid and accurate feeding responses in about 7 days.

quote: 建立起良好的摄食反应后, 可在投喂活饵料鱼中搭配一些死饵料鱼投喂, 投喂前, 先少量试投, 待鳜浮上水面吃食时, 再大量投喂。且投喂死鱼时要慢慢地投, 以便延长死鱼落下的时间。使鳜能充分饱食死饵料或鱼块。然后慢慢地逐渐增加死饵料或鱼块的比例, 最后过渡到全部投喂死鱼。
statement: 在建立良好摄食反应后，通过少量试投、慢速投喂以延长下落时间并逐渐增加比例的方法，可将鳜鱼从吃活饵过渡到吃死饵。
text_zh: 在建立良好摄食反应后，通过少量试投、慢速投喂以延长下落时间并逐渐增加比例的方法，可将鳜鱼从吃活饵过渡到吃死饵。
text_en: After establishing a good feeding response, mandarin fish can be transitioned from eating live bait to dead bait by using a method of small test feedings and slow feeding to prolong the falling time and gradually increasing the proportion.

quote: 鳜食性驯化过程结束后(一般在开始驯食后第16 d), 可凭鳜外观饱满或消瘦分为对死饵料鱼接受者或拒食者。
statement: 经过16天的食性驯化后，可根据鳜鱼的外观（饱满或消瘦）区分其对死饵料的接受程度。
text_zh: 经过16天的食性驯化后，可根据鳜鱼的外观（饱满或消瘦）区分其对死饵料的接受程度。
text_en: After 16 days of dietary acclimatization, the acceptance of dead bait by mandarin fish can be distinguished based on their appearance (plump or thin).

quote: 通过驯养, 能逐步诱导部分鳜以非活饵为食。
statement: 通过驯养可以逐步诱导部分鳜鱼食用非活饵。
text_zh: 通过驯养可以逐步诱导部分鳜鱼食用非活饵。
text_en: Domestication can gradually induce some mandarin fish to eat non-live bait.

quote: It was showed that some S. chuatsi could be induced to take lifeless bait with domestication gradually after long-term of cultiva-tion.
statement: 经过长期养殖驯化，部分鳜鱼可被诱导摄食死饵。
text_zh: 经过长期养殖驯化，部分鳜鱼可被诱导摄食死饵。
text_en: After long-term aquaculture domestication, some mandarin fish can be induced to feed on dead bait.

quote: High cost, serious pollution, severe diseases, and other problems of S chuatsi cultivation can be solved effectively by selecting those liable to domestication via molecular marker and treating them with artificial feed on a large scale.
statement: 通过分子标记选择易驯化个体并大规模投喂人工饲料，可有效解决鳜养殖的高成本、严重污染和疾病等问题。
text_zh: 通过分子标记选择易驯化个体并大规模投喂人工饲料，可有效解决鳜养殖的高成本、严重污染和疾病等问题。
text_en: Selecting easily domesticated individuals through molecular markers and feeding them large amounts of artificial feed can effectively solve problems such as high costs, severe pollution, and diseases in mandarin fish farming.
intervention_record: 分子标记选育与人工饲料

quote: 通过驯养, 能逐步诱导部分鳜以非活饵为食, 即为易驯化鳜, 而另一部分鳜则至死都只以新鲜活饵为食, 即不易驯化鳜。
statement: 通过驯养可以诱导部分鳜摄食非活饵，但存在个体差异，部分鳜始终只摄食活饵。
text_zh: 通过驯养可以诱导部分鳜摄食非活饵，但存在个体差异，部分鳜始终只摄食活饵。
text_en: Domestication can induce some mandarin fish to feed on non-live bait, but individual differences exist; some mandarin fish always feed only on live bait.

quote: 梁旭方等[2,3]在幼鳜食性驯化取得成功的基础上, 又在水库网箱中开展了鲜鱼、鱼块和配合饲料驯饲鳜鱼2 龄鱼种(体长17~21 cm)的试验, 获得成功, 驯化率分别达到100%、100%和88.4%。
statement: 在水库网箱中对2龄鳜鱼进行鲜鱼、鱼块和配合饲料驯饲试验均获成功，驯化率分别为100%、100%和88.4%。
text_zh: 在水库网箱中对2龄鳜鱼进行鲜鱼、鱼块和配合饲料驯饲试验均获成功，驯化率分别为100%、100%和88.4%。
text_en: In reservoir cage culture, taming trials for 2-year-old mandarin fish using fresh fish, fish chunks, and formulated feed were all successful, with taming rates of 100%, 100%, and 88.4%, respectively.

quote: 白质梯度, 配以混合油、维生素预混料、矿物质预混料制成6 个不同蛋白质梯度( 32. 61% ) 56. 30%) 的软颗粒饲料( 表1) , 置冰柜中备用; 每组饲料均有四个重复, 共24 个养殖单位, 每个养殖单位喂养30 尾实验鱼。
statement: 研究制备了六个不同蛋白质梯度的软颗粒饲料，并在24个养殖单位中每单位饲养30尾实验鱼进行试验。
text_zh: 研究制备了六个不同蛋白质梯度的软颗粒饲料，并在24个养殖单位中每单位饲养30尾实验鱼进行试验。
text_en: Six soft pellet feeds with different protein gradients were prepared, and the experiment was conducted in 24 rearing units, each stocked with 30 experimental fish.

text_zh: 在鳜食性驯化操作程序的第1至3天，于黄昏时分投喂过量的活饵料鱼。

statement: 在鳜食性驯化操作程序的第4至6天，每天逐步减少活饵料鱼的投喂量。
text_zh: 在鳜食性驯化操作程序的第4至6天，每天逐步减少活饵料鱼的投喂量。
text_en: During days 4 to 6 of the feeding domestication procedure for mandarin fish, the amount of live bait fish fed was gradually reduced each day.

text_zh: 在鳜食性驯化操作程序的第7天，仅进行饱食投喂活饵料鱼。
text_en: On day 7 of the dietary acclimation procedure for mandarin fish, only live baitfish were fed ad libitum.

statement: 在鳜食性驯化操作程序的第8至10天，每天逐步使用死饵料鱼替代活饵料鱼。
text_zh: 在鳜食性驯化操作程序的第8至10天，每天逐步使用死饵料鱼替代活饵料鱼。
text_en: During days 8 to 10 of the feeding habit domestication procedure for mandarin fish, dead bait fish were gradually used to replace live bait fish each day.

仅投喂死饵料鱼

statement: 在鳜食性驯化操作程序的第12至14天，每天逐步使用鲜鱼块替代死饵料鱼。
text_zh: 在鳜食性驯化操作程序的第12至14天，每天逐步使用鲜鱼块替代死饵料鱼。

statement: 通过剪断鳃部动脉或断尾及鳃部动脉的方式在水中放血以获取样本。
text_zh: 通过剪断鳃部动脉或断尾及鳃部动脉的方式在水中放血以获取样本。
text_en: Blood was drained in water by severing the gill arteries or by severing the tail and gill arteries to obtain samples.

statement: 实验前暂养池中用砖块或不透明材料制成人工洞穴供鳜鱼栖息。
text_zh: 实验前暂养池中用砖块或不透明材料制成人工洞穴供鳜鱼栖息。
text_en: Before the experiment, artificial caves made of bricks or opaque materials were placed in the holding tanks for mandarin fish to inhabit.

quote: 鳜( Siniperca chuatsi) 是终生以活鱼虾为食的凶猛鱼类, 其独特的摄食活饵食性制约着鳜集约化养殖规模。
statement: 鳜终生以活鱼虾为食的习性限制了其集约化养殖的规模。
text_zh: 鳜终生以活鱼虾为食的习性限制了其集约化养殖的规模。
text_en: The habit of mandarin fish feeding on live fish and shrimp throughout their life limits the scale of its intensive aquaculture.

quote: 国内学者梁旭方[ 1] 、吴遵霖[ 2] 通过对鳜摄食行为和摄食感觉机理的研究, 突破了鳜主动摄食配合饲料的难题;
statement: 通过研究摄食行为和感觉机理，解决了鳜主动摄食配合饲料的问题。
text_zh: 通过研究摄食行为和感觉机理，解决了鳜主动摄食配合饲料的问题。
text_en: By studying feeding behavior and sensory mechanisms, the problem of mandarin fish actively consuming compound feed was solved.
intervention_record: 摄食行为与感觉机理研究

quote: 作者经多年努力, 建立了鳜群体驯化技术, 使鳜能够主动抢食配合饲料,
statement: 建立的群体驯化技术使鳜能够主动抢食配合饲料。
text_zh: 建立的群体驯化技术使鳜能够主动抢食配合饲料。
text_en: The established group domestication technique enabled mandarin fish to actively compete for formulated feed.

quote: In addition, hawthorn pectin and hawthorn total organic acid inhibit oxidative stress-induced damage by increasing antioxidant enzyme activity and reducing oxidation product generation, while hawthorn flavonoid components mainly regulate Nrf2 sig­naling pathway-related proteins and factors to alleviate ox­idative stress.20
statement: 此外，山楂果胶和山楂总有机酸通过增加抗氧化酶活性和减少氧化产物生成来抑制氧化应激诱导的损伤，而山楂黄酮类成分主要通过调节Nrf2信号通路相关蛋白和因子来缓解氧化应激。
text_zh: 此外，山楂果胶和山楂总有机酸通过增加抗氧化酶活性和减少氧化产物生成来抑制氧化应激诱导的损伤，而山楂黄酮类成分主要通过调节Nrf2信号通路相关蛋白和因子来缓解氧化应激。
text_en: In addition, hawthorn pectin and total organic acids of hawthorn inhibit oxidative stress-induced damage by increasing antioxidant enzyme activity and reducing the generation of oxidation products, while flavonoid components of hawthorn mainly alleviate oxidative stress by regulating proteins and factors related to the Nrf2 signaling pathway.

text_zh: 研究表明，当归多糖可显著提高石斑鱼（Epinephelus malabaricus）和卵形鲳鲹（Trachinotus ovatus）幼鱼的抗氧化能力。
text_en: Studies have shown that Angelica sinensis polysaccharides can significantly improve the antioxidant capacity of juvenile grouper (Epinephelus malabaricus) and pompano (Trachinotus ovatus).

On the other hand, compound herbs inhibit lipid syn­
thesis and enhance lipid uptake to avoid fat accumulation
in the liver and reduce liver damage.
statement: 复方草药抑制脂质合成并增强脂质摄取，以避免肝脏脂肪积累并减少肝损伤。
text_zh: 复方草药抑制脂质合成并增强脂质摄取，以避免肝脏脂肪积累并减少肝损伤。
text_en: Compound herbal medicine inhibits lipid synthesis and enhances lipid uptake to avoid hepatic fat accumulation and reduce liver injury.

text_zh: 复方中草药对鳜鱼血清生化指标的影响。
text_en: The effect of compound Chinese herbal medicine on serum biochemical indicators of mandarin fish.

text_zh: 随着复方中草药添加量的增加，鳜鱼血清丙氨酸氨基转移酶（ALT）水平显著降低。
text_en: As the addition amount of compound Chinese herbal medicine increased, the serum alanine aminotransferase (ALT) level of mandarin fish decreased significantly.

text_zh: 随着复方中草药添加量的增加，鳜鱼血清天冬氨酸氨基转移酶（AST）水平显著降低。
text_en: As the addition amount of compound Chinese herbal medicine increased, the serum aspartate aminotransferase (AST) level of mandarin fish decreased significantly.

quote: The results showed that CF-fed fish exhibited higher levels of lysozyme (LZM) activity, malondialdehyde (MDA), triglycerides (TGs), and glucose in multiple tissues (brain, liver, kidneys, muscles, stomach, pyloric caecum, intestines, and blood) compared to LF-fed fish ( p 0.05), indicating greater energy retention and microbial resistance but weaker antioxidant capacity.
statement: 与投喂活饵的鱼相比，投喂配合饲料的鳜鱼在多个组织中表现出更高的溶菌酶活性、丙二醛、甘油三酯和葡萄糖水平，表明其能量保留和微生物抵抗力更强，但抗氧化能力较弱。
text_zh: 与投喂活饵的鱼相比，投喂配合饲料的鳜鱼在多个组织中表现出更高的溶菌酶活性、丙二醛、甘油三酯和葡萄糖水平，表明其能量保留和微生物抵抗力更强，但抗氧化能力较弱。
text_en: Compared to fish fed live bait, mandarin fish fed formulated feed showed higher lysozyme activity, malondialdehyde, triglyceride, and glucose levels in multiple tissues, indicating stronger energy retention and microbial resistance but weaker antioxidant capacity.
outcome: 应激反应与生理生化指标

quote: The intestine was particularly affected by dietary differences.
statement: 肠道受饮食差异的影响尤为显著。
text_zh: 肠道受饮食差异的影响尤为显著。
text_en: The gut is particularly significantly affected by dietary differences.

quote: If the temperature rises, it will have a negative impact on the liver function [ 17 ], immune function [ 18 , 19 ], and meat quality [ 20 , 21 ] of the fish.
statement: 温度升高会对鱼类的肝功能、免疫功能和肉质产生负面影响。
text_zh: 温度升高会对鱼类的肝功能、免疫功能和肉质产生负面影响。
text_en: Increased temperature has negative effects on fish liver function, immune function, and meat quality.

quote: Among these transportation methods, physical improvement and temporary culture before transportation [ 23 , 24 , 25 , 26 ], anesthesia during transportation [ 27 ], temperature control, oxygenation, and appropriate density [ 28 , 29 ] can all reduce transportation stress on fish and improve their survival rate during transportation.
statement: 运输前的体能改善和暂养、运输中的麻醉、温控、充氧以及适宜密度等措施均能减少鱼类的运输应激并提高其运输存活率。
text_zh: 运输前的体能改善和暂养、运输中的麻醉、温控、充氧以及适宜密度等措施均能减少鱼类的运输应激并提高其运输存活率。
text_en: Pre-transport physical conditioning and holding, as well as anesthesia, temperature control, oxygenation, and appropriate density during transport, can all reduce transport stress in fish and improve their transport survival rate.
intervention_record: 运输前体能改善与暂养

quote:
并对诱导级鱼
摄取人工饲料有参考价值
statement: 该研究旨在为诱导级鱼摄取人工饲料提供理论参考。
text_zh: 该研究旨在为诱导级鱼摄取人工饲料提供理论参考。
text_en: This study aims to provide a theoretical reference for inducing fish to consume artificial feed.

实验前于室内水池中暂养
, 池内用砖块做成洞穴供缘鱼栖息
statement: 实验前将级鱼在室内水池中暂养，并设置砖块洞穴供其栖息。
text_zh: 实验前将级鱼在室内水池中暂养，并设置砖块洞穴供其栖息。
text_en: Before the experiment, grade fish were held in indoor water pools, with brick caves provided for them to inhabit.
